headline: Anthropic raises $93.5 billion total as underwriters scoop up ‘greenshoe’ overallotment
author: Ashley Capoot

paragraphs.text: Anthropic underwriters have officially exercised their overallotment of shares in the historic initial public offering, bringing the total raised to $93.5 billion, according to a release on Friday.
The artificial intelligence company raised $81.3 billion on Wednesday and net an additional $12.2 billion through the overallotment, surpassing SpaceX, which held a record IPO in June.

Anthropic said it sold an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares at $83 per share in the offering. It sold 980 million shares on Wednesday and its underwriters had the option to purchase up to an additional 147 million shares by Friday as part of the overallotment, which is commonly referred to as the "greenshoe."
Shares of the Claude maker closed 17% higher in their first day of trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday, but they've fallen more than 11% in pre-market trading on Friday as a tech selloff intensifies.
